escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a vast dark space at night with a thin haze; far behind her, softly out of focus, an immense field of thousands of unlit dark glass cards recedes into the darkness): a MEDIUM-WIDE shot of her SEATED at a long review table of matte oiled walnut with no reflections, centered, wearing a sleek, form-fitting BIONIC SUIT in deep navy with matte white armored plates on the shoulders, chest and forearms, thin glowing azure-blue (#0375DB) light seams along the plates; the chest plate is plain, smooth white with NO emblem, NO logo, NO symbol, NO rocket, NO lettering; no watch, no bracelet and no ring, sleek futuristic wraparound glasses with CLEAR TRANSPARENT lenses lightly tinted azure blue, a thin frameless edge and a fine glowing azure line along the top of the lenses; her eyes are clearly visible through the transparent lenses, no mirror reflection covers her eyes. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: a MEDIUM-WIDE vertical shot; we sit across the same table from her, the camera at her seated eye level and tilted slightly upward, 85mm; the whole review table and the five cards are in frame in the lower third, and a tall, empty expanse of dark hazy space fills the upper part of the frame above her head. On the table in front of her lie EXACTLY FIVE thin glass cards in one neat, compact row, evenly spaced (one, two, three, four, five), plain, with NO text, NO symbols and NO marks on them; the row spans only the central two thirds of the frame width, and both ends of the table are empty. A single fine trace of azure-blue (#0375DB) scan light runs along the row of five cards and stops on ONE of them, which glows; her right hand rests lightly on that lit card, caught at the exact moment she pauses her review and looks up straight into the lens with a quiet, confident half-smile. The lit card is the brightest element; a cool rim light from behind separates her from the dark; every other card stays dim. The band between 10% and 32% of the frame height is calm, deep dark space with only faint haze, no cards, no light, no objects. The near half of the table is in deep shadow, outside every light: the scan light only touches the cards and never reaches the near edge. Enormous contrast, no text, no logos of any other brand. No monitors, no plants, no lamps.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the matte oiled walnut review table she is working at, only a few centimetres in front of the lens, in deep shadow, outside every light, with no reflections
lecho.tono: DARK walnut in deep shadow, near black

texto.muro: calm, deep dark space with only faint haze
